asr_text: Then the investigation took an unexpected turn. The fact that it doesn't show up became evidence. The authors used the line's absence from images to estimate its equivalent width, a measure of the line's features. They found it was at least 7,620 angstroms. This did not mean it was exactly 7,620 angstroms. It meant it was at least that much. The empty space had become a clue that could help narrow down the source.
